author: 2Legit2quit
quote:
Not sure this is a GTA game, more like red dead redemption with a GTA skin.

Positives - 
graphics are good

Negatives - 
Night time is ridiculously dark.

Main characters are boring and unlikable. Jason mumbles and Lucia is high maintenance annoying.

Can't keep found weapons or clothing without saving them at a wardrobe or car.

Cars are hard to handle and drive.

Missions are mainly running errands at the start 

Game cost £90 and can't keep the items after certain points in the game or if you cancel monthly membership.

Honor system from RDR2 ruins the game - it's GTA!!

Can't steal cars without certain tools, police can find stolen car and hard to lose the cops unless you change clothes, weapons or vehicles which is tedious.

Can only carry a certain amount of guns. Have to constantly change at the car, like the horse on RDR2. Again this is tedious.

Quite a few bugs, however these aren't game breaking and make the game more like a game rather than the realism simulator they've gone for.

Overalls this game is VERY disappointing and doesn't feel like the old GTAs. Even the humour **** the bottom of the barrel, with it seemingly meant to be funny that everything is referenced to body parts or sex.
